Container.Name: LumaLod-RSNode
Container.Overview: RealityScan render node for LumaLod Studio: RSNode.exe from RealityScan for Linux (Epic's Wine build) with NVIDIA GPU (CUDA + Vulkan), so Studio uses the same RSNode API as on a Windows node.[br][br] RealityScan is NOT part of the image. Download the RealityScan for Linux .deb (Epic login, realityscan.com/en-US/linux) and put it into the Installer folder; the container unpacks it into the RealityScan install folder on first start and again only when the .deb changes.[br][br] FIRST START: Mode = login and set a VNC password. Open http://UNRAID-IP:6080/vnc.html, sign in to Epic in RealityScan, close it. Then Mode = rsnode and clear the VNC password. The sign-in is kept in the AppData folder.[br][br] SECURITY: trusted LAN only. RSNode speaks plain HTTP, accepts any client that has its bearer, and the bearer does not change across restarts.[br][br] Requires the NVIDIA Driver plugin (nvidia runtime) and the Vulkan Support plugin (Martynyuu/unraid-vulkan).
Container.Requires: NVIDIA Driver plugin (provides the nvidia Docker runtime) and Vulkan Support plugin (Martynyuu/unraid-vulkan). The RealityScan for Linux .deb from Epic (not included).
Container.Description: RealityScan render node (RSNode under Wine) for LumaLod Studio, NVIDIA GPU. RealityScan itself is not included - supply the .deb from Epic.
Container.Changes:
### 2026.10.27 - Now the LumaLod Studio render node: RSNode.exe under RealityScan's bundled Wine on port 30010 (MODE=rsnode). - MODE variable (rsnode, login, remote, inventory, bash) replaces the invalid "Command" setting and the invented server/grpc modes. - RealityScan is unpacked into a persistent folder, only again when the .deb changes; Epic sign-in kept in AppData. - VNC/noVNC only with a VNC password, configured at runtime (no default password). - GPU via --runtime=nvidia + NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES/NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES; single NVIDIA .so mounts removed. - Healthcheck against /node/status.
### 2026.03.18 - Added NVIDIA library mounts for proper GPU/Vulkan support - Added /dev/dri device access - Fixed headless Xvfb initialization
### 2026.03.02 - Initial release

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: rsnode = render node for Studio. login = RealityScan GUI for the one-off Epic sign-in (needs a VNC password). inventory = diagnostics in the log, then stops. remote = Epic's Remote Command Plugin REST (port 1234). bash = idle, for the console.

Config.Name: RSNode port
Config.Description: RSNode API. Studio: reality_scan.bind_host = Unraid IP, bind_port = this port, auto_launch = false. The WebUI link answers 401 'Missing authentication token' when RSNode is up - that is expected (the API needs the bearer).

Config.Name: noVNC port
Config.Description: Browser desktop for MODE=login: http://UNRAID-IP:6080/vnc.html. Only active when a VNC password is set.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Turns on VNC/noVNC (required for MODE=login). Leave empty in normal operation. VNC uses only the first 8 characters.

Config.Name: Installer folder (.deb)
Config.Description: Put the RealityScan for Linux .deb here (newest one is used). Replace it to update RealityScan.

Config.Name: AppData (home, Wine prefix, Epic sign-in)
Config.Description: HOME of the container. RealityScan keeps its Wine prefix (~/.realityscan) and the Epic sign-in here.

Config.Name: RealityScan install
Config.Description: Unpacked RealityScan (several GB). Must be empty or a previous install - the container refuses to overwrite anything else.

Config.Name: Data (RSNode sessions)
Config.Description: RSNode session sandboxes (uploads, outputs) in /data/sessions. Use a cache/SSD pool. Studio removes sessions with /project/delete; /project/close alone leaves them on disk.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: all, or the GPU UUID from nvidia-smi -L

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: all (compute for CUDA, graphics for Vulkan, display/utility)

Config.Name: Vulkan ICD (host)
Config.Description: Host Vulkan ICD manifests from the Vulkan Support plugin. Used when the NVIDIA runtime does not inject a manifest itself.

Config.Name: RSNode extra args
Config.Description: Space-separated, no quotes. -allowedHosts tower.lan;tower is needed when Studio connects by host name instead of IP (RSNode rejects unknown Host headers with 403). It is not access control.

Config.Name: RSNode port (container)
Config.Description: Only change together with the container side of 'RSNode port'.

Config.Name: Loopback relay port
Config.Description: Empty = off. Set to 30011 only if Studio cannot read the bearer over the LAN (see README). Hands the bearer to anyone who can reach that port.

Config.Name: Relay port
Config.Description: Host port for the loopback relay (only used when 'Loopback relay port' = 30011).

Config.Name: VNC port
Config.Description: Raw VNC for a VNC client (only with a VNC password).

Config.Name: Remote Command port
Config.Description: Only MODE=remote (Epic's Remote Command Plugin REST).

Config.Name: DRI device
Config.Description: Optional (Epic's sample passes /dev/dri). Leave empty unless /dev/dri exists on the host.
